author: Yffe
content: Critic pin (audits #200/a0d8ea64): commit the failing test forge/tests/divergence_audit_check2_exit_swallow.rs. It extracts audit.sh check [2] verbatim and runs it against a fake forge reproducing cli.rs::run_tv's real contract (render_report header '1 DIVERGENT' + EXIT_VERIFICATION_FAILURE=1). Current script treats the nonzero exit as 'not admitted' (prog_admit=0; continue), never parses the report, prints green 'ok <name> 0 divergent' and 'PASS ZERO divergent across the whole corpus' with RC=0. Control probe (same output, exit 0) trips the gate — the swallow is isolated to the exit-code branch. Authority: the script's own 'PASS iff ZERO Divergent' contract, R-HONEST-3/R-DEFER-9. Generator must consume the verification-failure exit as a finding (parse the report on exit 1, or fail the program) — not reclassify it.
